author: Bellular News
description:
GameStop just bid $55 billion to take over eBay, framed as a bet on physical games right when online retail is faltering. CEO Ryan Cohen signed his compensation deal in January and the bid landed in May. What happened in between is the whole story.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
